lead: # NO build script of its own. `build.rs` in this directory is the SHARED script 54 other crates point
# their `build =` key at; auto-detection would run it FOR THIS PACKAGE, which owns no records, and the
# "opted in but no record" hard error would fail the build of the materializer itself.
# `graph-materialize` — the materializer that turns records in the committed graph store into the
# IT USED TO BE ONE FILE and no package: a bare `build.rs` pointed at by `build = "../graph-materialize/
# build.rs"`. That is still how the 54 existing adopters reach it — the file is unchanged in role, and
# its output is byte-identical — but a shared FILE cannot be taken as a `[build-dependencies]` entry and
# CALLED, which is what a crate that already owns a build script needs. `src-tauri` is exactly that
# crate, and it is the largest un-migrated body in the repo.
# LEAN ON PURPOSE: `serde_json` and nothing else. This is a build-dependency of ~54 crates, so anything
# added here is compiled before any of them can start.
sections.name: [dependencies]
